200:t_1:90.en:
$$レド$$
「But... My body felt hot. Like when I watched $$エイミー$$ dance with the $$ガルガンティア$$ fleet.」

200:t_1:91.en:
$$エイミー$$
「So you understand $$バサラ$$'s songs too, $$レド$$.」

200:t_1:93.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「You could say you feel them. $$バサラ$$'s songs hit you in the heart.」

200:t_1:94.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I have a question for Captain $$ガムリン$$. Do you mean the special energy waves he emits?」

200:t_1:95.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「I think what you detected was $$バサラ$$'s 《$$歌エネルギー$$》, $$チェインバー#pilot$$.」

200:t_1:96.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「But regardless of that physical power, $$バサラ$$ sings songs that touch people's hearts.」

200:t_1:98.en:
$$アンディ$$
「By the way, I like $$シェリル$$'s songs just as much!」

200:t_1:99.en:
$$サザンカ$$
「I'd go with $$ランカ$$! Sparkle!」

200:t_1:100.en:
$$レド$$
「Those are the two we rescued yesterday...」

200:t_1:101.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「Their songs are good too. Listen to them when you get a chance.」

200:t_1:102.en:
$$カイエン$$
「...But in the end, Vice Foreign Minister $$リリーナ$$ and the others weren't at $$ネオ・アルカトラズ$$.」

200:t_1:103.en:
$$アマタ$$
「Maybe they're somewhere else because they're VIPs...」

200:t_1:104.en:
$$ゼシカ$$
「But by that logic, aren't $$シェリル$$ and $$ランカ$$ VIPs too? They were being held somewhere special.」

200:t_1:105.en:
$$カイエン$$
「Even so, they're different from politically important people.」

200:t_1:106.en:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
「The Federation military took the rescued civilians into protective custody, but we still don't know the Empire's goal...」

200:t_1:109.en:
$$シュレード$$
「...$$ミレーヌ$$. You said earlier that the Empire had been pursuing $$Ｆｉｒｅ　Ｂｏｍｂｅｒ$$.」

200:t_1:110.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「Yeah... They apparently had their eyes on us and chased us everywhere we went.」

200:t_1:111.en:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
「So $$サイデリアル$$ was targeting $$バサラ$$ after $$シェリル$$ and $$ランカ$$?」

200:t_1:112.en:
$$ゼシカ$$
「But Vice Foreign Minister $$リリーナ$$ and the prisoners have nothing to do with singing.」

200:t_1:113.en:
$$シュレード$$
「You're right... So there's a hole in that theory...」

200:t_1:114.en:
$$エイミー$$
「But if we win the next battle, the war with $$サイデリアル$$ will end, right?」

200:t_1:115.en:
$$ミコノ$$
「That's right. Then we're sure to find out where the other prisoners are too.」

200:t_1:116.en:
$$アマタ$$
「I guess we can investigate why $$サイデリアル$$ is abducting civilians afterward...」

200:t_1:119.en:
$$エイミー$$
「Hey, $$アルト$$. I'd like to hear $$シェリル$$ and $$ランカ$$'s songs.」

200:t_1:120.en:
$$アルト$$
「Sorry, $$エイミー$$. $$ランカ$$ seems a little tired.」

200:t_1:121.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「How is $$シェリル$$ doing?」

200:t_1:122.en:
$$アルト$$
「She's with $$ランカ$$. She must have had a hard time in the prison camp too...」

200:t_1:124.en:
$$アマタ$$
「I heard they'll stay with $c for now, because of that incident with $$ミカゲ$$ too...」

200:t_1:125.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「But isn't that dangerous? We're about to charge into the enemy's stronghold...」

200:t_1:126.en:
$$アルト$$
「Then we'll just end the war with the Empire there. Once we do, things will settle down.」

200:t_1:128.en:
$$レド$$
「It's almost time for the meeting. Let's go.」

200:t_1:130.en:
$$レド$$
「...I feel the same as $$エイミー$$. I'd like to hear those two sing.」

200:t_1:133.en:
$$アルト$$
(Just wait, $$シェリル$$, $$ランカ$$... We'll end this war ourselves. I promise.)

200:t_1:139.en:
$$ロラン$$
「Yes... He's been acting strange ever since he came back from scouting.」

200:t_1:140.en:
$$ランド$$
「He's got a sensitive side. That's probably why.」

200:t_1:141.en:
$$ガロード$$
「I get why he's shocked. Major $$カリーニン$$'s report was hard for me to take too.」

200:t_1:142.en:
$$シン$$
「But, how do I put this... I feel like there's more to it.」

200:t_1:143.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「$$宗介$$ and the others are checking on him now. $$セツコ$$, do you have any idea what's wrong?」

200:t_1:144.en:
$$セツコ$$
「...I think $n senses them too. The Empire's $$リアクター$$s.」

200:t_1:145.en:
$$ランド$$
「Probably. That $$バルビエル$$ and $$尸空#pilot$$ must be in $$ラース・バビロン$$.」

200:t_1:146.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「$$ゼロ$$ and $$スメラギ$$ expect the same from a strategic standpoint.」

200:t_1:147.en:
$$シン$$
「Well, that's only natural. They know we're coming for a decisive battle...」

200:t_1:148.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Then we'll just crush them too.」

200:t_1:149.en:
$$ランド$$
「I'm sure $n thinks so too. He's probably making up his mind right now.」

200:t_1:150.en:
$$セツコ$$
「I agree. He's strong enough to resist despair.」

200:t_1:155.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Seeing that look on your face puts me a little more at ease.」

200:t_1:156.en:
$$ランド$$
「I taught him that $$ヒートスマイル$$. It's pretty good, huh?」

200:t_1:157.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Miss $$スズネ$$ seems a little unhappy about it, though.」

200:t_1:159.en:
$n
「Don't worry, Miss $$スズネ$$. I couldn't manage such a swelter... such a fiery smile myself.」

200:t_1:160.en:
$$ランド$$
「Hey! What were you about to say, $n!?」

200:t_1:161.en:
$n
「Nothing...! It was just a slip of the tongue...」

200:t_1:162.en:
$$ランド$$
「You little punk! You were secretly laughing at your mentor's smile, you trendy brat!」

200:t_1:163.en:
$$セツコ$$
「I think blaming $n for that would be a bit cruel.」

200:t_1:164.en:
$$ランド$$
「You too, $$セツコ$$...? Maybe passionate men are out of fashion these days...」

200:t_1:165.en:
$$メール$$
「Don't worry, don't worry! You'll always be on the cutting edge of fashion to me, darling!」

200:t_1:166.en:
$n
「So that's how it is, Miss $$スズネ$$. There's nothing to worry about.」

200:t_1:168.en:
$n
「Let's do this, Miss $$スズネ$$. Let's free Earth from the Empire.」
